video_title: Tony Allen Reacts To A Delonte West Clip About Their Friendship

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen on his former teammate Delonte West's recovery
quotes.excerpt: I'm glad he, you know, he back on his feet he back on, you know.
quotes.quote: I'm glad he, you know, he back on his feet he back on, you know. He clean, he been clean about, I want to say two years now. He look good and I thought one of the highlights of my day, and me just watching him, I thought when they asked him, 'Yo, any of your teammates you probably had fun with,' you know, and you know you going to have a good time, you always look forward to hanging with, he said, 'I had a lot on them, I had a lot on them,' and then he bust out, he was like, 'Well, shit, Tony Allen.' That damn near cracked me up. I literally almost cried because that was my brother when we first got drafted, we just locked in.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen credits Delonte West for Darren Erman's Celtics job
quotes.excerpt: Delonte West is responsible for Darren Erman getting a job with the Celtics.
quotes.quote: Delonte West is responsible for Darren Erman getting a job with the Celtics. I met him in an elevator in Vegas and we start talking about stuff, and that's your guy. That's Delonte West's guy first though. Darren, the head assistant for the Knicks. Oh, Erman. I met him in an elevator in Vegas and we start talking about stuff, and that's your guy.
